history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

lunal.description: Lunal, the deep stair-scum path (borg_think_dungeon_lunal, borg_flow_take_lunal), munchkin off: borg_self_lunal enters the mode when the Borg is prepared for 15 levels deeper and maxdepth >= depth + 15 (borg-think-dungeon.c), so an arm needs a long suite - or a deep-start suite the zoo does not have yet - or it measures nothing. The 0101/0101a fixes live on this path and only exist from 4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661 on. borg_plays_risky must stay off (a risky Borg is in a hurry and never enters).

munchkin-class.description: Munchkin start by class: today's product default for Warrior, Druid and Ranger (stair-scumming at depth 6), every other class ordinary. The arm that replaces implicit default in class grids. Names only borg_munchkin_by_class: for WDR classes the rule then forces the munchkin start itself, so borg_munchkin_start must stay unnamed (naming it FALSE contradicts the rule and reads as a config_error). Runs only on builds that know borg_munchkin_by_class (better-borg-c fd683ced and later).

normal.description: Ordinary play with every mode flag pinned off: no munchkin start, no munchkin by class, no Lunal. The arm every change can be checked against. Only builds that know borg_munchkin_by_class (better-borg-c fd683ced and later) can run it; older builds ignore the unknown setting, the observer cannot verify it, and the run is a config_error.

4.2.6-bbc-m12.label: better-borg-c milestone 12 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v12): v11 plus one carry (0118 NEWKILL-95: borg_new_kill() no longer forces a newly seen wall-walker's grid to floor) and the official angband import to master 42cd156a (12 commits past e473720, 5 of them in the Borg), which retires carries 0001 and 0002. Carries 115 = 116 + 1 - 2, counted here from the milestone package, not stated there. The milestone package says the retired carries' effect and the import's per-mode effect are not measured; this is the zoo's measurement of them. The tag message is a placeholder.

4.2.6-bbc-m13.label: better-borg-c milestone 13 runtime head 9ccb2aae (PR 519): nineteen carries since impact v12 - twelve from the issue-426 queue (0119-0130) and seven from the 2026-11-13/14 source-board pairs (0131-0137). Carries 134 = 115 + 19, counted here from the milestone package, not stated there. The 4.2.6-impact-v13 tag was placed on this commit on 2026-11-14 (owner authorization, borg-zoo#87 comment), so the tag now names the pin and the ref is unchanged; src/ at the later head cfcb6f13 is identical. The package records the per-mode effects as not measured. The prepared M12/M13 aggregate comparison and within-M13 policy grid do not discharge that per-unit debt; see docs/M13-MEASUREMENT.md (borg-zoo#87).

smoke.description: better-borg-c frozen cohort v1: 3 seeds, 20,000 engine turns

experiment.description: Can M12 and M13 build and apply each explicit mode profile on the three frozen smoke seeds? This is an 18-cell build/configuration and reachability probe, not a survival comparison. The lunal flag permits the mode; it does not prove mode entry. A run with no entry or no execution of the changed branch is not exercised, never a neutral result for Lunal fixes. The unrestricted/source-gated variants required by issue #87 are not supplied by these profiles. Prepared only; no dispatch authorized by this definition.
experiment.name: m12-m13-modes-smoke
